title: Pfeilstorch: A new scene for the Inexact Sciences
body:
_**TL;DR**: Existing knowledge institutions and legitimation pipelines are in crisis. Pfeilstorch is a new, institutionally unaffiliated community for knowledge production, built on a Commonwealth fork and using Edgeware's treasury and governance structure to award microgrants and reputational credit. Our plan is to leverage the chaos of the current moment, and the emergence of new Web3 paradigms, to build cultural technology that supports decentralized research and philosophy. Our focus lies on those topics that existing institutions have shunned due to their messy unreadiness for formal verification and data collecting—topics in the “[inexact sciences](https://twitter.com/literalbanana/status/1247400947472404482?s=21),” such as human communication, social strategy, and representation in the wild._

## Intro

The last decade has seen major changes in research and publishing, as a wave of young thinkers forego traditional institutions for online scenes. And yet old-school forums remain the go-to platform where such writers and researchers can engage in long-form discussion. Substack isolates its writers in semi-paywalled digital newsletters. Twitter, an [“oral” culture](https://twitter.com/ctbeiser/status/1401775079139155970), is too noisy, fragmented, and disorganized for participants to build lasting frameworks together. The Commonwealth forum is a step in the right direction, but currently lacks tools specific to research and publishing. What is needed are discursive platforms which hybridize discussion and publishing, that generate new ideas while keeping cultural memory: a true Web3 knowledge production scene, a system of watering holes for decentralized thinkers. Yet the few present rallying points for “Game B” (i.e. institutionally unaffiliated) thought are [presently](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Intellectual_dark_web) [consumed](https://twitter.com/peternlimberg/status/1289241648912728065) [by](https://letter.wiki/topics/65)
